chapter: Family, Margaret's story and Eutris's memories
title: From Social Circle to Decatur and Morris Brown
summary: The family moved from Social Circle to Atlanta then Decatur; at 14 he entered boarding school at Morris Brown.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: But he was born in Social Circle. How long did he stay in Social Circle before he came to Decatur?
He was about 8 years old when we moved from Social Circle. We moved to Atlanta and Decatur's 6 miles from Atlanta, so then my father bought a home out in Decatur and we moved out there.
So you went from Social Circle to Atlanta to Decatur?
Yes, that's right, then back to Atlanta. I think my parents had moved here and you moved back to Atlanta when you started to school. You lived with my brother. You started to school at Morris Brown.
And that was in Atlanta. Which brother was that?
That was Garnett. He went to boarding school; he didn't stay with my brother.
Now we got him at about 14, 13 or 14.
When he started. What about the earlier training, say up until the period of 14 what did he do?
Where did he go to school?
Oh, he went to school in Decatur?
He went to elementary and so forth there?
Yes, until he, when he was 14, went to boarding school at Morris Brown.
